statement.p: Finally, find all critical points in the graph of f(x)

p.em: (Enter your x-values as a comma-separated list, or
if there are no critical points.)

static.solution: f'(x) > 0 and f'(x) \lt 0; critical points are where f'(x) = 0. Here f'(x) = -3 x^2 + 3 = -3 ( x - 1 )( x + 1 ), so f is increasing on (-1, 1) and decreasing on (-\infty, -1), (1, \infty). Critical points are x = -1 and x = 1.
